authority: Owner ruling O2 of 2026-11-17 adopted these defaults as starting numbers, editable in this one file. The two cap values and the allowed ages were not named in the ruling: they are placeholders marked owner_set false.
owner_set_default_note: Fields marked owner_set false are the builder's placeholders; the page labels them as such until the owner edits the file.

acceptance.note: 753 daily points through 2026-11-06; two missing daily points filled by span returns. If a later release materially changes the index, flag the change to the owner.

zones.NO_NEW_RISK: No new risk, no leverage increase, no new strategy. Rebalance moves wait; reductions to cash are allowed.

breach_action.note: The ruling says the pre-set reduction applies over the limit but names no amount. Until the owner sets one here the page says so instead of inventing a number.

status_rule.ratio: live drawdown divided by prior worst drawdown

stress_rule.label: Stress loss, policy rule re-applied at the cutoff: each strategy loses max(1.25 x its prior worst drawdown, 1.5 x its worst live drawdown), plus 5 points where its live history is platform-only, capped at 100%; every strategy at that loss on the same day. A scenario, not a forecast.
stress_rule.backtest_ruling: Control ruling 2026-11-16, mechanical re-application of the owner's own rule; the owner may overturn.

p123-ai-factor.source: the correlation-one loss audit of 2026-11: hybrid backtest plus live maximum drawdown

p123-eu.source: same audit: governed backtest maximum drawdown (2008), vendor series across a calendar gap

qsi.source: same audit: prior used by the policy constant

volatis-strategy.source: same audit: prior used by the policy constant

grizzlybears-vtma.source: same audit: governed backtest maximum drawdown

robuxio-crypto.source: same audit: prior used by the policy constant

stress_rule.dependency: PR 971 restates the stress number in the payload with the same rule. When its payload field is present this block prefers it; until then the page computes the figure from the payload weights and the numbers above.

targets.method: Weight in inverse proportion to the stress loss fraction, pulled halfway to equal weight, then capped.

data_ages.basis: Days from the evaluation date to each source's data date.
